Modification_Detail.description: First PDS release of IUVS products
Second PDS release. This collection is only extended with new data -- no data from the previous version has been reprocessed

Third PDS release. Additional upper-level products have been added, and uncertainty has been modified in level 1C periapse. All products have been reprocessed with the new software, even if this would not change the data.

Fourth PDS release. Wavelength scale is improved in level 1B, and all upper-level products use this modified wavelength scale. Additional upper-level products have been added. All products have been reprocessed with the new software, even if this would not change the data.
Fifth PDS release. This collection is only extended with new data -- no data from the previous version has been reprocessed.
Sixth PDS release. A bug in dark subtraction has been fixed.
Seventh PDS release. Periapse retrieval is based on DN, rather than calibrated, images. MUV calibration curve shifted 7nm. Several pixel geometry fields have been modified.

Twelfth PDS release. A bug in special observations where the scan mirror was commanded to not move has been fixed. A bug that caused some special observations late in an orbit to have the wrong orbit number has been fixed.
Thirteenth PDS release. Full mission reprocess and changes to L1C airglow templates.
IUVS V14 Full Mission Reprocess. Added additional geometry information now in the PIXELGEOMETRY HDU.

Field_Binary.name: DATA_COMPRESSION
Field_Binary.description: If data compression is on, all detector data will be sent in 16 bit pixels. If compression is off, the data can be up to 32 bits wide and it will be different for each bin. Compression should always be enabled unless taking a full frame image.

Field_Binary.name: TEST_PATTERN
Field_Binary.description: There are two types of test patterns that can be produced. The 16 bit pattern rolls over at 65535 and the 12 bit pattern rolls over at 4095. This indicates which type will be used for the next test pattern image.

Field_Binary.name: ON_CHIP_WINDOWING
Field_Binary.description: In linear bin mode, the Detector FPGA can read the entire array into SRAM and bin it from there, or it can only read out the pixels in the defined window. Running with the window enabled can save readout time.

Field_Binary.name: BIN_TYPE
Field_Binary.description: There are two types of binning, linear and non-linear. This indicates which the detector will use for the next set of images.

Field_Binary.name: SCAN_MODE
Field_Binary.description: The detector can peform three different types of readouts, in addition to generating a test pattern. This indicates which readout will be used for the next set of images.
